title: Nonzero zero-scale limits force the blow-up centres to lie within O(λ_i) of N, and x ∈ N (parent step 3)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U, N, E ⊆ ℝ^P, ξ_N : ℝ^P → Λ_{n+1}(ℝ^P), T ∈ 𝒟_n(U), x ∈ ℝ^P, points x_i ∈ ℝ^P and scales λ_i > 0 (i ∈ ℕ), and S ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P). Assume (closure N ∖ N) ∩ U = ∅, E ⊆ N, T(ω) = ∫_E ξ_N(z)(dω(z)) dH^{n+1}(z) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^n(U) (IsBoundaryOfRegion T E ξ_N), x ∈ U, x_i → x, λ_i → 0, the blow-ups η_{x_i,λ_i#}T (blowUp T x_i λ_i) converge weakly to S in ℝ^P (ConvergesWeakly: currentEval(η_{x_i,λ_i#}T)(ω) → S(ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^n(ℝ^P)), and spt S ≠ ∅. Then x ∈ N, and there is C₀ > 0 such that for every i some p ∈ N satisfies |p − x_i| ≤ C₀λ_i.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U N E : Set (Euclid P)) (ξN : Euclid P → MultiVector P (n + 1)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (x : Euclid P) (xs : ℕ → Euclid P) (lams : ℕ → ℝ) (hlams : ∀ i, 0 < lams i) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), (closure N \ N) ∩ U = ∅ → E ⊆ N → IsBoundaryOfRegion T E ξN → x ∈ U → Tendsto xs atTop (𝓝 x) → Tendsto lams atTop (𝓝 0) → ConvergesWeakly (fun i => blowUp T (xs i) (lams i) (hlams i).ne') S → S.support.Nonempty → x ∈ N ∧ ∃ C₀ : ℝ, 0 < C₀ ∧ ∀ i, ∃ p ∈ N, dist p (xs i) ≤ C₀ * lams i
